Thoracic surgeries and scoliosis surgeries do not require medical review or authorization. Starting September 1, 2015, BCBSNE will require prior approvals for BCBSNE members and their dependents for these services. C ervical and Lumbar spine surgery services rendered through the Emergency Room are not managed by National Imaging Associates (NIA) and will not require a pre-service review Requirements for the BCBSNE pre-service review include: · Preauthorization required for coverage. If a pre-service authorization is not completed for these services, the claims for services will be denied as provider liability without opportunity to balance bill the impacted BCBSNE member for the services. However, the claim will be held for review against the criteria to determine if post-discharge services may be eligible for coverage . · Services will not be covered if criteria are not met. If a pre-service authorization request is submitted and Evolent determines that criteria are not met, benefits are not available. If the BCBSNE member chooses to receive the services (and provides written authorization), the claim will deny as member liability. In addition, post-discharge services necessitated by the procedure will also be member liability. · Submission of the pre-service review. o call toll free 1-866-972-9642 from 7:00am - 7:00pm (CST) (8:00am-8:00pm EST). o visit the website www.RadMD.com Dates Original Effective 09-01-2015 Last Review 05-06-2026 Next Review 05-05-2027 Quick Code Search Use this feature to find out if a procedure and diagnosis code pair will be approved, denied or held for review.
